corporate-development-associates-in-hous.problem: Keep deal modelling sharp for the transactions the team runs (accretion/dilution, LBO, comps): a self-study modelling course
corporate-development-associates-in-hous.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 1). Bought by the associate, often reimbursed. Standard entry purchase for ex-consultants and anyone whose modelling has gone rusty.

corporate-development-associates-in-hous.problem: Learn the buy-side playbook (sourcing, diligence, integration) from practitioners: an M&A practitioner membership with playbooks and templates
corporate-development-associates-in-hous.note: Replaces the old step 2 price ($1,800 per year seen on a third-party blog). The vendor's own pricing page title shows Professional membership at $995/yr; the same search showed the newer DealPilot Practitioners tier at $1,995/year on mascience.com/membership. Employer usually pays.

corporate-development-associates-in-hous.problem: Run live deals without spreadsheets and email: deal pipeline and diligence software (one project room)
corporate-development-associates-in-hous.note: New step. Same page shows $1,000/month on annual billing ($12,000/year) and that the Pipeline plan is annual-only at $12,000/year. The company pays, but the associate or manager is the buyer who picks and runs it. Moderate confidence that small corp dev teams commonly pay; many still use Excel and the seller's data room.

corporate-development-associates-in-hous.problem: Move up to manager or director: an executive M&A and corporate development course
corporate-development-associates-in-hous.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 3). Employer-funded in most cases.

corporate-development-associates-in-hous.problem: The MBA pivot for the minority who reset: admissions consulting plus the GMAT
corporate-development-associates-in-hous.note: Old steps 4 and 5 (GMAT, admissions consultant) merged: they are one problem, getting into an MBA. GMAT fee seen at USD 275 at a test center or USD 300 online (https://test-ninjas.com/gmat-registration-fees-and-cost). Only a minority of the room takes this route.

desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.problem: Try designer and niche scents cheaply before committing: decants from an Indian decant seller
desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 1). The universal first purchase in this community.

desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.problem: Buy the first full bottle from an Indian niche house
desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 3), moved earlier because full bottles usually come before attars for people who enter through designer decants.

desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.problem: Go traditional: attars from Kannauj (rose-oud, 10 ml)
desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 2). Sale price; the regular price shown was ₹1,999.00.

desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.problem: Chase rarer juice: niche decants and bottle splits
Import a bottle not sold in India and pay customs duty on it
desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.price_text: around 43% to 44% of the overall CIF value
desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.note: New step. Search showed the stack as 20% basic customs duty, a 10% social welfare surcharge on the duty, and 28% IGST on top (cusbuzz.com pages show 20.00% BCD for HSN 33030010/33030090). Paid by everyone who orders from abroad by post; a large minority of the room, since many others buy on Dubai trips or through relatives. Moderate confidence on 'commonly'.

desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.problem: Start blending: a perfume-making workshop, then a starter kit of oils and perfumer's alcohol
desi-fragrance-addicts-india-community.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 5), widened to include the kit that follows: VedaOils Perfume Making Kit seen at ₹999 (regular price ₹2,000) at https://www.vedaoils.com/products/perfume-making-kit. Kept as one step because both solve 'make my own'.

gre-preppers-worldwide-online.problem: Structured prep: a self-study course with practice questions and tests
gre-preppers-worldwide-online.note: Old steps 1 and 2 merged: the cheap subscription (GregMat, $11.99 per month, https://www.gregmat.com/pricing) and the fuller course are substitutes for the same problem, not a sequence. Magoosh price reused from the old ladder.

gre-preppers-worldwide-online.problem: Know the real score before test day: official ETS practice tests beyond the two free ones
gre-preppers-worldwide-online.note: New step. POWERPREP PLUS Online; three paid tests exist. r/GRE treats them as the only trustworthy score predictor, so most serious preppers buy at least one.

gre-preppers-worldwide-online.problem: Break a score plateau after self-study: hourly tutoring
gre-preppers-worldwide-online.note: New step. Kaplan's entry rate on a tutor comparison page; the same page shows Wyzant tutors from about $30/hour and Manhattan Prep at $270-$290 per hour. A minority of the room, but a large one given the volume of tutor offers in the community.

gre-preppers-worldwide-online.problem: Sit the exam, and reschedule or retake when the score is short
gre-preppers-worldwide-online.note: Old steps 3 and 4 (registration, reschedule) merged: one problem, getting a usable score. Fee rose from $220 to $249 on 1 August 2026 per the search; the Magoosh fee page still showed $220 and a $55 rescheduling fee (https://magoosh.com/gre/gre-exam-fee-and-cost/). Retakes pay the full fee again.

gre-preppers-worldwide-online.problem: Prove English for the same applications (non-native applicants, the majority of the room): TOEFL or IELTS
gre-preppers-worldwide-online.note: New step. TOEFL iBT fee in India (base INR 15,254 plus 18% GST). Applies to the non-native slice, which is most of the room; US applicants skip it.

gre-preppers-worldwide-online.problem: Send scores and apply: additional score reports and application fees for each school beyond the four free recipients
gre-preppers-worldwide-online.note: Replaces the old step 5, whose price ($220) pointed at a prep-course page. Most applicants send to more than four schools. University application fees come on top; no single price cited here.

gre-preppers-worldwide-online.problem: Get the essays right: SOP and LOR editing or an admissions counsellor
gre-preppers-worldwide-online.note: New step. Price for a college-admission SOP from an Indian SOP service; the same search showed US services at $30 to $150 per SOP. Commonly bought by the Indian slice; US applicants more often use free university writing centres.

indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.problem: Get the product online: hosting for a production app (plus a domain)
indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.note: New step. Vercel Pro is the most common host in this community; a domain adds roughly $10-15 a year (no single price cited). Small but universal.

indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.problem: Incorporate from anywhere so Stripe, customers and acquirers take you seriously
indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 1); the page title now shows the renewal too. Stripe Atlas, one-time $500 covering state filing, EIN and first-year registered agent.

indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.problem: Keep the company alive and legal each year: Delaware annual tax, registered agent, and the foreign-owner tax filing
indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 2), widened: most indie hackers are outside the US, so they also pay a Form 5472 filing service, seen at $299 flat (https://form5472.tax/), plus a registered agent at $60-$149 a year.

indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.problem: Sell worldwide without handling sales tax and VAT: a merchant of record
indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 3) with the vendor's own pricing page; Paddle charges the same headline rate.

indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.problem: Get found now that buyers ask ChatGPT and Google AI instead of browsing: SEO and AI-search visibility tooling
indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 4). Newer than the SEO tools this room already buys; moderate confidence that it is 'commonly' paid yet.

indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.problem: Learn to price, sell and not quit: a paid founder community with masterminds
indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.note: Replaces the old step 5 price ($97 per month from a generic Skool listing). MicroConf Connect, the bootstrapped-SaaS community; also $499/year.

indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.problem: Exit: sell the product on a startup marketplace
indie-hackers-bootstrapped-founders.note: New step. Acquire.com closing fee on the purchase price; listing is free. Selling a small product is a normal end of the indie-hacker cycle, and this is the default venue.

non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.problem: Learn the interview game: an investment banking interview guide
Pass the technicals: a financial modelling course
Reach alumni and bankers without on-campus recruiting: LinkedIn Premium for InMail and profile views
non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.note: New step. Cold outreach is the non-target's whole strategy; Premium Career is the common paid tool for it, usually after the free month.

non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.problem: Rehearse with someone who has sat on the other side: paid mock interviews and coaching with an ex-banker
non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.note: Replaces the old step 3, whose $800/hour price pointed at a course page. Single mock-interview session price from a coaching comparison page; multi-session packages $500-$3,000 on the same page.

non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.problem: Buy a structured path: a mentored recruiting program built for non-targets
non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 4). Reviewer-reported price; the vendor does not publish it.

non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.problem: Add a credential the resume screen respects: CFA Level I
non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.note: New step. Early registration price for 2026 exams; standard is US$1,490 and the separate enrollment fee was dropped from February 2026. A common non-target move, debated endlessly on WSO, so kept despite being a minority purchase.

non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.problem: If recruiting fails: the graduate-school reset (MSF or MBA), starting with the GMAT and often admissions help
non-target-students-breaking-into-financ.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 5). Admissions consulting on top was seen at $7,300 for 1 school (https://poetsandquants.com/2023/05/31/what-it-now-costs-to-hire-an-mba-admissions-consultant/).

self-directed-value-investors-community.problem: Company financials, estimates and screens in one place: a data terminal subscription
self-directed-value-investors-community.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 1). Old step 3 (Koyfin, $39 per month) dropped as a substitute for the same problem, not a next step.

self-directed-value-investors-community.problem: Research, ratings and other people's write-ups: a research subscription
self-directed-value-investors-community.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 2). Seeking Alpha Premium.

self-directed-value-investors-community.problem: Learn valuation the way bankers do it: DCF, comps and three-statement models
self-directed-value-investors-community.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 5), moved earlier: it usually follows the first year of paying for data and realising the numbers need a model.

self-directed-value-investors-community.problem: Pay for ideas from a named analyst: a paid value-investing newsletter or private idea community
self-directed-value-investors-community.note: Replaces the old step 4 price ($29.99 a month from an anonymous Gumroad club). Value Situations, a value-ideas Substack; the same search showed Morningstar StockInvestor at $199/year.

self-directed-value-investors-community.problem: Track performance and capital gains across brokers for tax time: a portfolio tracker
self-directed-value-investors-community.note: New step. Sharesight Starter; Standard $18 and Premium $23.25 per month on the same page. Bought once holdings outgrow the broker's own reports, typically in year two or three.

small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.problem: Fit out the space (and the next one) with pallet racking
small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.note: Replaces the old unpriced step 5 (lease and fit-out). Single-deep selective racking; used racking 30-50% cheaper on the same site. The lease itself is rent, not a product, and no lease-negotiation price was seen, so it is folded into this step's note only.

small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.problem: Run picking, packing and inventory for many brands at once: a warehouse management system built for small 3PLs
small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 1). Zenventory Starter, up to 10,000 shipments, one warehouse.

small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.problem: Cover the brands' goods you hold: warehouse legal liability insurance, which every brand contract demands
small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.note: New step. Required for any 3PL holding others' goods; general liability and workers' comp sit on top.

small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.problem: Win brand clients: a 3PL-owner community with contract templates and ad playbooks, plus paid leads from directories
small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 2), widened. Directory lead fees were seen in search at $50 - $500 per lead with a $199 monthly listing fee (https://www.fulfill.com/3pl-network); another directory sells a one-time fee per 'opportunity to quote' (https://www.warehousingandfulfillment.com/become-a-vendor/).

small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.problem: Staff the Q4 peak without hiring permanently: temp labour through a staffing agency
small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.note: New step. Agency markup on W2 temp pay; another result said warehouse markups over 40% are rare (https://www.instawork.com/blog/staffing-agencies-fees). Nearly every e-commerce 3PL uses temps for the holiday peak.

small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.problem: Pass the security questionnaires bigger brands send before signing: a first SOC 2 audit
small-3pl-fulfilment-warehouse-operators.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 6). Old steps 3 (AI search visibility tracking) and 4 (AI voice agent platform) dropped: no evidence this room commonly pays for either yet.

rooftop-solar-installers-epc.problem: Certify installers (NABCEP in the US) to qualify for incentives and win bids
rooftop-solar-installers-epc.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 1). Search this pass showed the exam fee as $375 for members and $475 for non-members, with a $275 re-exam fee.

rooftop-solar-installers-epc.problem: Quote accurately and fast: design and proposal software, paid per user
rooftop-solar-installers-epc.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 2). Aurora Solar.

rooftop-solar-installers-epc.problem: Fill the pipeline: buy homeowner leads from lead marketplaces
rooftop-solar-installers-epc.note: Old step 3 split and priced: per-lead price now seen on the page the old ladder cited. Shared leads $50-$150, exclusive $150-$400 on the same page.

rooftop-solar-installers-epc.problem: Offer customers a low-APR loan: the dealer fee the lender charges the installer on every financed system
rooftop-solar-installers-epc.note: New step, carved out of the old step 3 (financing). Percentage of system cost; another result put the typical range at 15-30% (https://www.energysage.com/solar/solar-loans/understanding-solar-loan-fees/). The largest recurring cost in this ladder for US residential installers.

rooftop-solar-installers-epc.problem: Get each job permitted: engineer-stamped plan sets for the permit office
rooftop-solar-installers-epc.note: New step. Residential electrical PE stamp; structural stamps $200-$400 and commercial $500-$1,500 on the same page. Paid per project by installers without an in-house engineer, which is most of the room.

rooftop-solar-installers-epc.problem: Stay insurable for customers and lenders: contractor general liability insurance
rooftop-solar-installers-epc.note: New step. Example premium for a solar contractor with $1,000,000 in sales; small installer programs 'start at just under $2,000 a year' per https://gdiinsurance.com/contractors/solar-power-installers-insurance/.

rooftop-solar-installers-epc.problem: Move up to commercial rooftops: bankable yield studies (PV simulation software)
rooftop-solar-installers-epc.note: Reused from the old ladder (step 4). PVsyst. Old step 5 (monitoring and maintenance contracts) dropped: no price seen and the installer sells rather than buys O&M.
